\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[plain,noline,longend]{algorithm2e}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}

An unnumbered plain-style algorithm with the long end keywords.

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\SetKwFunction{Split}{Split}
\SetKwProg{Fn}{Function}{:}{end}
\SetKwRepeat{Repeat}{repeat}{until}
\SetKw{KwRet}{return}
\KwData{A list $L$ of $n$ items}
\KwResult{A sorted list}
\Fn{\Split{$L$}}{
  \tcc{halve the list}
  \Repeat{$n < 2$}{
    $n \gets n / 2$\;
  }
  \Switch{the parity of $n$}{
    \Case{even}{\KwRet $L$\;}
    \Other{\KwRet \Split{$L$}\;}
  }
}
\caption{Splitting a list}
\end{algorithm}
